description: This file is an abstract base class for unit tests related to endpoint testing within the Eclipse Ditto gateway services. It sets up common configurations, mock actors, and test utilities for testing endpoint behaviors.

classes.name: EndpointTestBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing common setup, configuration, and utility methods for endpoint testing in the gateway services.

classes.name: DummyResponseAnswer
classes.description: Mock actor for simulating responses to messages for testing purposes.

classes.name: DummyThingModifyCommandResponse
classes.description: Mock implementation of command response for testing, carrying dummy JSON entity and headers.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Sets up static configuration components before all tests.

methods.name: additionalConfig
methods.description: Provides additional configuration, loads 'test.conf' for testing environment.

methods.name: createTestConfig
methods.description: Loads and returns the test configuration from 'test.conf'.

methods.name: createDummyResponseActor
methods.description: Creates an actor that responds with a dummy message for testing.

methods.name: createDummyResponseActor
methods.description: Creates an actor with custom response provider for testing.

methods.name: createClusterStatusSupplierMock
methods.description: Creates a mock supplier that returns an empty cluster status.

methods.name: createHealthCheckingActorMock
methods.description: Creates a mock actor that responds with health status info.

methods.name: withDevopsCredentials
methods.description: Augments an HttpRequest with devops credentials for testing.

methods.name: assertWebsocketUpgradeExpectedResult
methods.description: Tests that the websocket upgrade response is a bad request with the appropriate message.
